whisper_endmix: Buy now, pay later? Sounds like freedom. It's not. This holiday season, Americans are expected to spend over $21 billion on buy now, pay later. Small payments, big chains. Every later is a piece of your future you already sold. The rich don't buy now and pay later. They pay now and buy later. Wait, save. Then buy it in cash. Discipline today is freedom tomorrow. So before you click buy, ask yourself who will pay for this?
